chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hafiz al-Ju'abi told us, saying: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn Ziyad told me from the original book of his father, saying: His father told us, saying: Hafs ibn Umar al-Amri told us, saying: Isam ibn Taliq told us, from Abu Harun, from Abu Sa'id, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

Regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned.' He said: About the Wilayah (Divine Authority) of Ali: What did they do with his matter? And Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, had made them aware that he is the Successor after His Messenger.
ai.seo_question: What is the connection between Quran 37:24 and the Wilayah of Ali according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, the verse 'Stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned' (Surah As-Saffat, 37:24) is interpreted as a divine inquiry into the companions' handling of Ali ibn Abi Talib’s Wilayah. This exegesis highlights the theological weight of the succession event, framing the companions' actions—or inactions—regarding the Prophet’s explicit designation as a matter of future accountability before Allah.
